new_claims.statement: For a physical pair H with rank-one cross A[H,L]=g r^T, leaf block D, delta=det A[H,H], kappa=g^T adj(A[H,H])g, the anchored third-compound matrix N_H(i,j)=det A[H union {i},H union {j}] equals delta D-kappa rr^T exactly.

If the physical pair has exact rank one, its pair-to-leaf cross has rank one, Omega_(2,H)>=omega, and normalized physical star leverage q>=eta, then the full ambient form has ||p_Q||inf <=216 eta^(-1/3) omega^(-1/6), with arbitrary same-active-leaf curvature retained. Continuity is not claimed.
At Omega_(2,H)>=1/4, the exact singular rank-one pair/rank-one cross branch either has ||p_Q||inf<686 via a literal physical principal triple or else q<1/16.

structural_warning: At an exact rank-one physical pair, N_H=-kappa rr^T and is completely independent of the arbitrary same-leaf block D. Therefore overlap-two mass alone cannot control or reconstruct entangled leaf curvature.
stress_family: B=diag(1,0), g=e2, flat r_i=1/sqrt(m), D=t vv^T with v perpendicular r: spectrum {1,+1,-1,t} plus zeros for every t; N_H=-rr^T, P_H=1/m, Omega_(2,H)=1-1/m, q=1/m independently of t.

partner_applied.application: m=64, t=0 flat star; spectrum {1,+1,-1}; theorem gives ||p_Q||inf<=6 and P{Q in J}<=6|J|.

next_step: In the q<1/16 exact singular-pair/rank-one-cross branch, spend arbitrary same-bank curvature through another literal crossing/one-shared overlap/mixed-hub receiver or prove a direct diffuse-star curvature inequality; do not attempt to infer D from Omega_2.
